title_en: What are the five pillars of Islam?
match_phrases: what do muslims have to do

workflow.note: al-Bukhari 8 checked; order follows that narration.

explanation.en: The Prophet ﷺ said that Islam is built on five: bearing witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; establishing the prayer; giving zakat, the obligatory charity; the pilgrimage (Hajj); and fasting in Ramadan (al-Bukhari 8). Muslims call these the five pillars of Islam.
explanation.ar: أخبر النبي ﷺ أن الإسلام بُني على خمس: شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمدًا رسول الله، وإقام الصلاة، وإيتاء الزكاة، والحج، وصوم رمضان (البخاري ٨). ويسمّيها المسلمون أركان الإسلام الخمسة.
